description: A utility module providing various helper functions for ID generation, string manipulation, date formatting, DOM interactions, WebSocket data fixing, and role checks within the Mattermost/Focalboard web application.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A static utility class providing functions for ID creation, string encoding, date formatting, DOM manipulation, WebSocket data handling, role verification, and other helper methods.

methods.name: createGuid
methods.description: Generates a globally unique identifier string prefixed with the specified IDType.

methods.name: blockTypeToIDType
methods.description: Converts a block type string to its corresponding IDType enum value.

methods.name: getProfilePicture
methods.description: Returns the profile picture URL for a user, or a default SVG if unavailable.

methods.name: getUserDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a display name for a user based on configuration and user properties.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Constructs a full name string from user firstname and lastname.

methods.name: randomArray
methods.description: Creates a Uint8Array of specified size filled with cryptographically secure random bytes.

methods.name: base32encode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a base32 string, with optional padding.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a non-secure hash code for a string.

methods.name: htmlToElement
methods.description: Converts an HTML string into a DOM HTMLElement.

methods.name: getElementById
methods.description: Retrieves a DOM element by ID, asserting its existence.

methods.name: htmlEncode
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for HTML.

methods.name: htmlDecode
methods.description: Unescapes HTML entities in a string.

methods.name: getTextWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a text string given a font descriptor.

methods.name: getFontAndPaddingFromCell
methods.description: Extracts font and padding info from a table cell element.

methods.name: getFontAndPaddingFromChildren
methods.description: Recursively determines font and padding from child elements for table rendering.

methods.name: getFontString
methods.description: Constructs a CSS font string from style properties.

methods.name: getHorizontalMargin
methods.description: Calculates total horizontal margin from style.

methods.name: getHorizontalBorder
methods.description: Calculates total horizontal border width from style.

methods.name: getHorizontalPadding
methods.description: Calculates total horizontal padding from style.

methods.name: getTotalHorizontalPadding
methods.description: Calculates total horizontal spacing including padding, margin, and border.

methods.name: htmlFromMarkdown

methods.name: htmlFromMarkdownWithRenderer
methods.description: Converts Markdown text to HTML using a specified renderer.

methods.name: countCheckboxesInMarkdown
methods.description: Counts total and checked checkboxes in Markdown text.

methods.name: displayDate
methods.description: Formats a date for display based on locale, showing year only if not current year.

methods.name: inputDate
methods.description: Formats a date for input fields.

methods.name: displayDateTime
methods.description: Formats a date and time for display.

methods.name: relativeDisplayDateTime
methods.description: Displays relative time from now using moment.js.

methods.name: sleep

methods.name: assertValue

methods.name: assertFailure

methods.name: log

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Logs an error message with timestamp, only in non-production environments.

methods.name: logWarn
